title: NativeScript vs LynxJS

lostTrialTrees.reason: This study predates study-scoped trial branches. Its NativeScript trees were committed as trials/main-ns-N; the 2026-08-01 ns-vs-expo-buildonly run reused those exact names and force-updated them, so the 2026-07-25 trees are gone. Token results are unaffected (they come from archived transcripts), but the NativeScript arm cannot be rebuilt from source. The one surviving v1.0 tree is ns-benchmark main @ cc1f065.
lostTrialTrees.substitute: ref-ns-v1.0 measures ns-benchmark main @ cc1f065, the one surviving spec-v1.0 NativeScript tree from this study's 2026-07-25 window. It stands in for the lost per-trial trees as a single disclosed reference, which the ns-vs-expo run justifies: all 8 NativeScript archives there came out byte-identical in size, so NativeScript app size does not vary by implementation.

frozenReason: Published submission (2026-07-25). Historical numbers are never edited in place — a re-run under a changed model, framework version, or spec is a new study slug. Set ALLOW_FROZEN=1 only to reproduce, never to amend.
